source.title: Official 2025-26 NBA Playing Rules, Rule No. 1, court diagram (page 8)

notes: Origin is the visible baseline x far-sideline painted-centerline junction; +X runs toward midcourt and +Y toward the near sideline.
All ordinary lines are two inches wide. Each source value retains the diagram edge convention and a signed half-stripe conversion to canonical centerline geometry.
The three-foot corner gap is from the sideline inside edge to the three-point line outside edge, equivalent to the diagram's 22-foot outside basket distance.

line_width.diagram_label: ALL LINES SHALL BE 2 INCHES WIDE (NEUTRAL ZONES EXCLUDED)

half_length.diagram_label: LENGTH 94 FEET (inside), halved from baseline inside edge to division-line center

free_throw_distance.diagram_label: 19 FEET TO FREE THROW LINE (OUTSIDE); baseline-center to line-center offsets cancel

basket_from_baseline.diagram_label: 5 FEET 3 IN. from baseline inside edge to basket center

three_point_corner_inset.diagram_label: 3 FEET from sideline inside edge to three-point line outside edge (22 FEET OUTSIDE from basket)
